_comment: Portable, native-readable descriptor of the Insimul vegetation PCG graph (US-XG3). A real UPCGGraph .uasset is built from this at editor time by InsimulPcgVegetation::BuildOrLoadGraph (source of truth: this file, mirrors the base-templates.pl convention). The graph is SEEDED from the world IR's biome/density data: Insimul provides the semantic layout (which lots/roads/biomes exist and where) and PCG does the per-instance scatter. Parameter names here are the graph's exposed overridable parameters; InsimulPcgVegetation::FeedParametersFromIr fills them per biome band from the IR terrain slice.
name: PCG_InsimulVegetation
surfaceFrom: the sculpted Landscape (US-XG2) — the scatter runs on the landscape surface, masked away from road splines and building footprints

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.doc: Deterministic scatter seed; set to the world IR seed so a re-generate reproduces the same scatter.

parameters.name: PointsPerSquareMeter
parameters.doc: Base scatter density; scaled per biome band by DensityMultiplier.

parameters.name: SlopeMaxDegrees
parameters.doc: Vegetation is culled above this landscape slope.

parameters.name: RoadClearance
parameters.doc: Centimetres of exclusion around road splines.

parameters.name: FootprintClearance
parameters.doc: Centimetres of exclusion around building lot footprints.

nodes.doc: Samples the Landscape surface at PointsPerSquareMeter.
Multiplies point density by the biome band's DensityMultiplier read from the IR biome map.
Culls points whose landscape normal exceeds SlopeMaxDegrees.
Subtracts a RoadClearance buffer around the road splines.
Subtracts a FootprintClearance buffer around building footprints.
Randomizes scale in [MinScale, MaxScale] with the band's scaleJitter.
Spawns the biome band's resolved vegetation mesh (bound via the Asset Binding Layer) at each surviving point.
